E3 is built and tested. Refresh **http://maker:4001**, click **"Add 12 sample bookmarks"** (twice, so there's more than one page to work across).

A few decisions to judge as you go:
- Each bookmark now has a **checkbox**. A **"Select"** box at the top selects/clears everything on the *current page*; when your selection doesn't yet cover everything, a **"Select all N in this view"** link appears to grab every matching bookmark across all pages.
- When anything is selected, a **blue action bar** appears with: **Add tag… / Remove tag… / Mark unread / Mark read / Archive (or Restore) / Delete.** I mapped your *read/unread* to the states we settled: **"Mark read" = Done**, **"Mark unread" = To read**.
- After an action runs, the **selection clears**.

**Please try this:**

1. Tick a few individual checkboxes. Confirm the action bar shows *"N selected."*
2. Click **"Select"** at the top to select the whole page; then click **"Select all N in this view"** and confirm it grabs every matching bookmark, even those on the next page.
3. With several selected, click **"Mark read"** — confirm they all move to Done together (watch the tab counts).
4. Select some again, click **"Add tag…"**, type a tag like `to-review`, and confirm it's added to all of them at once. Try **"Remove tag…"** too.
5. Select a couple and click **"Archive"** — confirm they all move to Archived together. (In the Archived view the same bar offers **Restore** instead.)
6. Select some and click **"Delete"** — confirm the count-aware confirmation, then that they're all removed.
7. As a scope check: run a **search** to narrow the view, then **"Select all N in this view"** — confirm bulk actions apply only to the matches, not your whole collection.

Tell me: does selecting bookmarks — individually, a whole page, or everything matching a search/view — and acting on them together match what you intended? And is the **read = Done / unread = To read** mapping the right reading of "mark read/unread," or do you think of those differently?
